<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ScrollAreaRootProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/scroll-area'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { ScrollArea as VaseScrollArea } from '@vase-ui/vue/scroll-area'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import ScrollBar from './ScrollBar.vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ScrollAreaRootProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <VaseScrollArea.Root
    data-slot="scroll-area"
    :class="cn('relative', props.class)"
  >
    <VaseScrollArea.Viewport
      data-slot="scroll-area-viewport"
      class="size-full rounded-[inherit] transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-1"
    >
      <VaseScrollArea.Content>
        <slot />
      </VaseScrollArea.Content>
    </VaseScrollArea.Viewport>
    <ScrollBar />
    <VaseScrollArea.Corner />
  </VaseScrollArea.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ScrollAreaScrollbarProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/scroll-area'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { ScrollArea } from '@vase-ui/vue/scroll-area'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ ScrollAreaScrollbarProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  orientation?: ScrollAreaScrollbarProps['orientation']
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  orientation: 'vertical',
})
</script>

<template>
  <ScrollArea.Scrollbar
    data-slot="scroll-area-scrollbar"
    :orientation="orientation"
    :class="cn('data-horizontal:h-2.5 data-horizontal:flex-col data-horizontal:border-t data-horizontal:border-t-transparent data-vertical:h-full data-vertical:w-2.5 data-vertical:border-l data-vertical:border-l-transparent flex touch-none p-px transition-colors select-none', props.class)"
  >
    <ScrollArea.Thumb
      data-slot="scroll-area-thumb"
      class="rounded-none relative flex-1 bg-border"
    />
  </ScrollArea.Scrollbar>
</template>

export { default as ScrollArea } from './ScrollArea.vue'
export { default as ScrollBar } from './ScrollBar.vue'
